name: Uzbekistan
headline: Uzbekistan: +7.7% growth in 2025, 8.8% inflation, debt 29% of GDP
sections: Uzbekistan is a $147 billion economy (2025), the world's 62nd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +7.7% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $14K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 20.8% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 8.8% in 2025, above typical targets, down from 11.4% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 4.8% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 11.4% (2025).
Gross government debt is 29% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 32% in 2020. The general government balance is −1.6% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −3.9% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 57% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 3.0% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 25% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 72.5 years (2024). Population: 38.2 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
